buildings.name: Training Ground
levels: 3 Mentor seats; trained recruits promote at level 5.

orders.name: Drill a Scion hard
orders.text: One Scion trains with real blades all Year: +120 XP and +60 JP.

buildings.name: Scriptorium
levels: Insight 3; once a Year, peek one expedition event.

orders.name: Copy the bestiary
orders.text: The scribes copy out what the expeditions saw: +2 Lore.

buildings.name: Infirmary
levels: 2 Scions treated per Year; disease immunity in town.
A Devastating injury may be downgraded once per campaign.

orders.name: Surgery
orders.text: The surgeons reopen an old wound to set it right: one Scion's oldest lasting Moderate injury mends, and Sanity +10.

Mental ailment resist +10% for House Scions.
Resurrection and redemption events become possible.

orders.name: Keep a vigil
orders.text: A night of prayer against the Rift: Doom −1, and up to four of your Scions Sanity +15.

levels: Year order: craft a Common weapon or piece of armour.
Year order: craft a Fine piece.
Year order: forge a Masterwork with Wyrmbone.

orders.name: Craft a Common piece
orders.text: A Common weapon or piece of armour, its properties rolled.

orders.name: Craft a Fine piece
orders.text: A Fine weapon or piece of armour, its properties rolled.

orders.name: Forge with Wyrmbone
orders.text: A Masterwork, quenched in dragon marrow.

buildings.name: Workshop
levels: Tinkerers start with +1 Component; Year order: pack Firebombs.
Year order: build Caltrops and a Net.
Year order: grind Voidglass into Lanterns and Signal Flares.

orders.name: Pack firebombs
orders.text: Two Firebombs for the stores.

orders.name: Build traps
orders.text: Two sets of Caltrops and a Net.

orders.name: Grind Voidglass lenses
orders.text: Two Lanterns and two Signal Flares that burn in any dark.

orders.name: Feast the petitioners
orders.text: Word spreads of your table: a recruit joins your pool.

levels: Treasury score +10%; immune to theft events.
Treasury score +20%; 5% interest a Year on Gold.

orders.text: The House's saint walks with one Scion: Devout for a Year.

Haunting events can be bargained with.
The dead can be asked one question per Year.

orders.name: Ask the dead
orders.text: The dead teach one Scion what they learned too late: +150 JP and +2 Lore, Sanity −10.

orders.name: Work through the night
orders.text: Lamps in the fields till dawn: +10 Grain.

orders.name: Work through the night
orders.text: Axes by torchlight: +10 Timber.

orders.name: Work through the night
orders.text: The quarry never sleeps: +10 Stone.

levels: +24 Iron per Year; one random rare material every 3 Years.

orders.name: Work through the night
orders.text: Deeper and longer: +10 Iron.

orders.name: Give a Scion a hound
orders.text: A war-hound runs at one Scion's heel: Keen-Eyed for a Year.

buildings.name: Watchtower
levels: Preview next Year's settlement event category.
Ambush events on expeditions: your Scions act first.

orders.name: Light the signal fires
orders.text: Your tower burns all night over the city: Accord +2.
